summary: TROOPS, Inc. (NASDAQ: TROO), a Hong Kong-based fintech and insurance conglomerate, filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a US current report on Form 8-K) disclosing a conditional sale and purchase agreement with EFFORCE Group, the blockchain sustainability venture founded by Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak, who remains an EFFORCE shareholder post-close. The October 12, 2026 press release frames the deal as a merger expanding TROOPS into multi-vertical digital asset infrastructure, including carbon credit and green certificate trading. No price per share, stake percentage, premium, consideration mix, advisor, or expected closing date was disclosed; terms remain conditional and unsigned specifics are absent.
